files.description: NextGen Enterprise EHR EHI Data Dictionary (10,875 pages, ~2,097 tables). This is the Enterprise product's SQL Server database schema — NOT for NextGen Office, but it is the only downloadable artifact linked from the registered URL. Downloaded for reference/comparison.
